name: material-design
description: Guides Claude toward Material Design 3 (Material You), Google-style, responsive and adaptive UI. Ships 15 skills (design guide, responsive/adaptive layout, M3 + Google docs lookup, component creation, spec checking, templating, correction, MUI->M3 migration, plus one skill per @aphrody-code package: dynamic-color/tokens, Tailwind+shadcn theme, motion, design compiler, lint, doc-ai), 5 sub-agents (component builder, spec checker, migrator, corrector, Google-only design researcher), a hardcoded-color guard hook, and a bundled mui-docs MCP server (bun-native port of @mui/mcp). Token-accurate (HCT color roles, type scale, elevation, shape, motion, state layers, window size classes) and aligned with the material-web monorepo (@material/web + @aphrody-code/m3-*).
